pos.personaBrief: Juventus sat in a compact 4-4-2/5-3-2, were content to defend long periods and counter (Coaches' Voice, Tifo, Hudl); Allegri prefers danger over possession.

pro.personaBrief: Hudl: no elaborate first phase, avoids risk and builds wide; fast speed after recovery, safe passing, long ball to a free striker.

est.personaBrief: Formation-flexible with drilled roles, but wingers and forwards asked to drop between the lines (SoccerTutor); wide, spread build-up rather than tight rondo play.

lar.personaBrief: Width from wing-backs and full-backs, wide build-up with switches (Coaches' Voice, Hudl), though a central midfield density and few true wingers.

blo.personaBrief: Reserved, deep block, passive 4-4-2/5-3-2, press only in selected situations (Coaches' Voice, Tifo, Hudl, theScore); sits and waits.

mar.personaBrief: Zonal block with ball-oriented, man-oriented duties inside it (Hudl); occasional dedicated shadowing (Muntari on Xavi).

pla.personaBrief: Tactically flexible, adapts shape to opponent and players, even mid-match (Coaches' Voice, Tifo); 'football is strategy'.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic 'corto muso' results man, criticized as conservative (Hudl); defends leads, content with a draw away.

sis.personaBrief: Defensive sacrifice demanded of all, including substitutes (Hudl); organization over individuals, yet says champions count, not schemes (Goal 2018).

jog.personaBrief: Chooses ball-playing midfielders (Pirlo, Pjanic) but also tall, physical midfield density (Hudl) and duels; adapts to players.

bas.personaBrief: Built title teams on veterans and signings (BBC defence, Pirlo, Ronaldo); youth used mostly due to injuries (Goal 2022).

lid.personaBrief: Relaxed but capable of anger (Ibrahimovic), kept the dressing room calm, decided on his own and treated Bonucci like any player.
